name: rapid-reload-transaction
description: VER-01 / S4 T8. It runs the dedicated disposable-rapid-reload-proficiency-gate scenario, previously never executed because the authoring sessions were elevated: real LevelUpController transactions for the Rapid Reload parent and its firearm children (refusal, scoped-child refusal, empty child selection, acquisition, the Fighter bonus slot), a pending class change and a pending archetype change inside one live transaction with exact-child tracking and invalid-child cleanup, a natively built Musket Master, a class-identity negative control, visit-ownership on a failed initialisation, a cleanup-reporting injection, the native prerequisite matrix with request-local independent sources, catalog publication and classification, and party and unit isolation. No save is loaded.
